overview: A premium single-product landing page for Muscle Fuel Whey Protein — built with a luxury black and red gym aesthetic, WhatsApp ordering integration, flavor and quantity selectors, reviews, and a mobile sticky action bar.
features: Hero section with premium protein jar image, gym-themed visuals, and CTA buttons
Flavor and quantity selectors with real-time WhatsApp message customization
Pricing section with MRP, discount price, and offer badge
All CTAs open WhatsApp with pre-filled product inquiry messages
